name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
summary: Horde scouts find a waterlogged message inside Blackfathom Deeps. You carry the naga's note to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, where its words reveal a ritual plot deep within the flooded ruins.

sections.title: A Scribbled Declaration
sections.body: Horde scouts find a damp, crumpled note while battling the naga in Blackfathom Deeps. Its frantic handwriting gives orders to the naga priestesses: gather elemental water crystals. The crystals are not for random pillaging. They will fuel the summonings of naga aquamancers, who are marshaling elemental forces for a darker purpose.

sections.title: Whispers of the Deep
sections.body: The recovered orders say the naga will use the crystals' elemental energy to appease and fully summon Aku'mai, a monstrous hydra in the service of the Old Gods. The note claims this will herald the return of the world's greatest era, the prehistoric reign of the Old Gods. At Zoram'gar Outpost, Je'neu Sancrea, a Darkspear mystic, identifies the author as Lorgus Jett, a Twilight's Hammer cultist.

faq.answer: The Damp Note holds orders written by the Twilight's Hammer cultist Lorgus Jett. It tells naga priestesses to gather elemental-infused crystals to strengthen their aquamancers and summon Aku'mai, a monstrous servant.

Je'neu Sancrea is a Darkspear troll seer and scholar at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. He represents the Earthen Ring and investigates elemental imbalances and ancient threats rising from Blackfathom Deeps.

Lorgus Jett is a human shaman of the Twilight's Hammer cult, working inside Blackfathom Deeps alongside the naga. He oversees the gathering of elemental crystals to empower naga rituals and reawaken dark ancient horrors.

Aku'mai is a colossal three-headed hydra in the submerged depths of Blackfathom Deeps. The Twilight's Hammer cult and the naga revere the creature, which is bound to the primordial darkness of the Old Gods.

faq.q: Why are the naga collecting water crystals?
faq.answer: The naga gather water crystals to use the elemental spirits trapped inside them as raw power for their aquamancers. By siphoning that magic, they hope to appease Aku'mai and gather enough power to bring back the Old Gods.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain lead?
aliases: what comes after allegiance to the old gods
allegiance to the old gods part 2
faq.answer: Carrying the note to Je'neu Sancrea leads to a follow-up effort to track down and execute Lorgus Jett, disrupting the cult's ritual plans in Blackfathom Deeps.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you help uncover Lorgus Jett's note and protect Zoram'gar Outpost from the Twilight's Hammer and its naga allies, who threaten the Horde's foothold on Ashenvale's western coast.
As a shaman, you know that forcing water elemental spirits into ritual crystals perverts the natural balance and demands swift correction.
As a troll, you help your Darkspear kin Je'neu Sancrea uncover ancient cosmic entities whose return would threaten every tribe across Azeroth.
